Alias: Order ID, Order #, Reference ID, Order number:
Description: Unique order identifier, e.g. "4784457221". Source: "Order number:" label/value pair.
One entry per purchased line item (3 items in the fixture). Source: .collapsed-product-detail line-item cards.

Alias: Shipping Cost, Shipping Fee, Delivery Fee
Description: Shipping charge as a string; "0" when free.
Sum of all line totals, 2-decimal money, e.g. "80.10". Derived: sum of (Unit Price × Quantity).

Alias: Order Total, Total, Total Charged, Order total:
Description: Total charged incl. tax/shipping, 2-decimal money, e.g. "80.10". Source: "Order total:" label/value pair.

Alias: Sales Tax, Tax Amount, Estimated Tax
Description: Tax amount, 2-decimal money; "0" when zero. Derived: Grand Total - Subtotal - Shipping.

Alias: Payment Method, Card Type, Tender Type, Payment method:
Description: Card type; a retailer-branded card maps to "Store Card". Source: "Payment method:" text.

Alias: Item Name, Product Title, Title, aria-label
Description: Human-readable product title, e.g. "I.N.C. International Concepts Women's Sleeveless Cowl Neck Tank, Macy's Exclusive".
Number of units as a string, e.g. "1".

Alias: Item Total, Extended Price, Line Subtotal
